info.title: Setu UPI Issuance — TPAP API

parameters.name: X-Sim-Resolution
parameters.description: **QA / sandbox only.** Pins the values this resolution returns, so a person, a merchant, a verified payee, or a failure can be reproduced deterministically instead of depending on what a real payee PSP reports. The value is a JSON object of the fields you expect back, e.g. {"name":"Test Merchant","entityType":"ENTITY","verified":true} or {"status":"FAILED","errorCode":"ZH"}. Send it on every poll — it is read on the poll that returns RESOLVED. Ignored on production.

smsBody.description: The ready-to-send silent-SMS body. The app sends this verbatim to the VMN; the token is embedded here and is never returned separately.

vmn.description: The Virtual Mobile Number to send the SMS to.

mobile.description: The user's mobile number, with country code (e.g. 919999999999).

payeeVpa.description: The external payee VPA to block or unblock (prefix@handle; any handle).

blockedPayees.description: This page of the user's currently-blocked payee VPAs (newest-added first); empty when none.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

blockedAt.description: When the payee was most recently blocked (RFC3339).

unblockedAt.description: When the payee was unblocked (RFC3339); absent while blocked.

mobile.description: The user's mobile number, with country code (e.g. 919999999999).

programId.description: Optional program id (ULID). Validated when supplied.

vpa.description: The full VPA to check (prefix@handle, e.g. 919999999999-acme@setu). Its prefix must start with the user's alias (by default, their mobile number).

geocode.description: Current device geocode as "lat,long"; forwarded as the payer device GEOCODE tag.

mobile.description: The user's mobile number, with country code (e.g. 919999999999).

vpa.description: The payee VPA to resolve (prefix@handle). Resolved locally when the handle is ours, otherwise via NPCI.

amountLimit.description: Per-transaction cap, in paise. Omit for no cap.

code.description: The program's short code — its channel identifier.

isCreditAllowed.description: May wallets on this program receive incoming UPI? Defaults true.

isDebitAllowed.description: May wallets on this program pay outgoing UPI? Defaults true.

accountProviderId.description: The account-provider id. Optional when a TPAP default is configured.

defaultCredit.description: Make this VPA the user's default credit account.

defaultDebit.description: Make this VPA the user's default debit account.

ifsc.description: The IFSC of the account. Optional when a TPAP default is configured.

mobile.description: The user's mobile number, with country code (e.g. 919999999999).

otpRequired.description: Whether OTP verification is needed to activate the new VPA — set true for Android, false for iOS. When true, the VPA is created pending-verification until an OTP activates it; false (default) creates it active.

programId.description: Optional program id (ULID) — the program this VPA belongs to. Validated when supplied.

vpa.description: The full VPA to create (prefix@handle, e.g. 919999999999-acme@setu). Its prefix must start with the user's alias (by default, their mobile number).

mobile.description: The user's mobile number, with country code (e.g. 919999999999).

vpa.description: The full VPA to fetch (prefix@handle, e.g. 919999999999-acme@setu). Its prefix must start with the user's alias (by default, their mobile number).

cursor.description: The nextCursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Max entries to return this page. Omitted or non-positive defaults to 20; clamped to 100.

mobile.description: The user's mobile number, with country code (e.g. 919999999999).

isDebitAllowed.description: May wallets on this program pay outgoing UPI?

mobile.description: The user's mobile number, with country code (e.g. 919999999999).

os.description: The device OS: android or ios.

otpRequired.description: Set true for the device-change case where an OTP is needed after SIM binding (e.g. Android). Set false for iOS, or for the new-onboarding / new-VPA case where the OTP happens after VPA creation (gate it on create-vpa's otpRequired instead).

available.description: false means the VPA is already taken by another user's active VPA. A taken VPA is not an error.

vpa.description: The full VPA that was checked (prefix@handle).

accountType.description: The payee's account type. Present on RESOLVED.

brandName.description: Merchant brand name. Present for a resolved merchant.

entityType.description: The payee entity type: PERSON or ENTITY. Present on RESOLVED.

errorCode.description: NPCI error code. Present on FAILED (e.g. ZH for an invalid address).

errorMessage.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present on FAILED.

franchiseName.description: Merchant franchise name. Present for a resolved merchant.

genre.description: Merchant genre: ONLINE or OFFLINE. Present for a resolved merchant.

ifsc.description: The payee's IFSC. Present on RESOLVED.

legalName.description: Merchant legal name. Present for a resolved merchant.

mcc.description: Merchant category code. Present for a resolved merchant.

merchantType.description: Merchant type: SMALL or LARGE. Present for a resolved merchant.

name.description: The payee's masked account-holder name. Present on RESOLVED.

ownership.description: Merchant ownership type: PROPRIETARY, PARTNERSHIP, PRIVATE, PUBLIC or OTHERS. Present for a resolved merchant.

status.description: Resolution outcome: RESOLVED (details present), PENDING (poll again), or FAILED (error present).

verified.description: Whether the resolved payee VPA is in the verified/whitelisted registry. Present on RESOLVED.

verifiedLogo.description: The registered logo url/ref from the verified registry. Present when verified.

verifiedName.description: The registered display name from the verified registry. Present when verified.

verifiedUrl.description: The registered brand/callback url from the verified registry. Present when verified.

vpa.description: The payee VPA that was resolved (echo of the request).

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

vpas.description: This page of the user's live VPAs (newest-added first); empty when none.

mobile.description: The owner's mobile number, with country code.

programId.description: The program the VPA belongs to (ULID).
